items.activity: Build a sample 12-month budget-versus-actual sheet in Excel with a variance column and a one-paragraph monthly summary.

items.evidenceToAdd: Add it as a clearly labeled practice project.

items.activity: Ask which warehouse management system the team uses and whether training is provided.
items.why: This is a preferred skill, and many employers train on their own system.

items.activity: Learn the basic warehouse management system workflow: receiving, put-away, picking, and shipping.
